mapMarkers.title: 🐘 Stage
mapMarkers.description: The sacred stage where Pearl Cha Chintamani is enthroned. Located on the right/lower-right side of the apartment complex with royal floral mandap and evening aarti platform.

mapMarkers.title: 🪑 Seating
mapMarkers.description: Covered devotee seating area directly adjacent to the Stage with dedicated chair arrangements for senior citizens and families.

mapMarkers.title: 🚗 Parking
mapMarkers.description: Designated vehicle parking area located beside and around the Stage area along the eastern grounds. Follow volunteer directions upon arrival.

mapMarkers.title: 🚪 Main Gate
mapMarkers.description: Main campus entrance gate located on the right/lower-right perimeter. Primary entry point for devotees and visitors attending the festival.

memories.title: Pearl Cha Chintamani 2025 - "Svarnim Darshan"
memories.description: The celebrated 2025 Utsav featured our grand 9-foot eco-friendly idol and our first 100-member community Maha Aarti choir.
highlights: Over 1,200 devotees participated in the Sthapana Aarti
Traditional Dhol Tasha performance with 40 youth drummers

memories.title: Pearl Cha Chintamani 2024 - "Pratham Utsav"
memories.description: The foundation year when Pearl Community brought together all 3 towers for a grand 10-day cultural extravaganza.
highlights: Inaugural Pearl Community Ganesh Mandap erected at the Stage
Inter-tower cultural sports and rangoli festival
Tearful and joyous visarjan procession with thousands joining
